problem_contract.desired: retain the V16 entry stream while improving standalone-month adverse inventory outcomes with materially fewer auxiliary exits than V22
problem_contract.as_is: V22 consumed 3299 walk auxiliary signals and made 272 auxiliary exits; base was 1.0003273200 and adverse was 0.9918473609
problem_contract.gap: the M5 auxiliary exit reacted too frequently and paid more execution cost without producing stable monthly protection
problem_contract.fact: V22 adverse was 0.9991704799 in May and 0.9927199804 in June
problem_contract.hypothesis: a distribution-frozen, completed-H4 opposing-coherence event can identify a lower-frequency inventory exit state
problem_contract.counter_hypothesis: H4 confirmation is late or directionally wrong and will preserve losses without improving executable outcomes
problem_contract.minimum_test: one frozen Q75 feature-distribution threshold, the same V16 entries, and the same three cost arms
problem_contract.stop_condition: reject if base or adverse standalone-month admission fails; do not tune the opened months or increase leverage

single_changed_variable: replace V22 M5 auxiliary exits with a completed-H4 two-block coherence auxiliary exit

indicator.name: H4 Opposing Coherence Exit
indicator.aggregation: causal 48-M5-bar UTC H4 blocks; decisions only after a block is complete
indicator.candidate: the latest two non-overlapping completed H4 blocks have strictly same-sign log returns
indicator.coherence: absolute 96-bar log return divided by the square root of the sum of squared 5-minute log returns
indicator.threshold: nearest-rank Q75 of candidate coherence values in the tuning period, independent of outcomes and costs

inventory_policy.trigger: close an existing same-pair position only when it faces opposite the frozen H4 direction
inventory_policy.authority: the auxiliary event cannot open, add, reverse, resize, or extend inventory
inventory_policy.same_timestamp_order: apply auxiliary exit first, then the unchanged V16 primary signal
inventory_policy.max_age: retain the V16 H384 finite expiry and terminal liquidation

evaluation.universe: same seven USD majors as V16
evaluation.allocation: seven fixed 1/7 sleeves; gross cap 1.0; no leverage tuning
evaluation.comparison: V16 and V22 on the same periods, costs, entries, and terminal-zero contract

development_admission: normal and adverse equity multiples exceed 1.0 in the full walk and each standalone month
the auxiliary event stream and actual exit count are reported separately
multiplicity: Count V23 as the third hypothesis in the H4-context short-timeframe family.
